# NEW 2026-11-18 round 6 B3, the shared Ottoman bet framework. Generated by gen_bet_framework.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope. Opens a bet. Before calling, save the claimants as scope:oe_bet_p1, scope:oe_bet_p2 and, if there is one,
# scope:oe_bet_p3 (p1 should be the claimant who holds the throne). round: see ROUNDS in gen_bet_framework.py.
oe_bet_open = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_bet_round value = $round$ }
    remove_variable = oe_bet_resolved
    remove_variable = oe_bet_winner
    remove_variable = oe_bet_wc
    remove_variable = oe_bet_out_won
    remove_variable = oe_bet_out_lost
    remove_variable = oe_bet_out_aloof
    set_variable = { name = oe_bet_back value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_bet_stake value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_bet_m value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_bet_c1 value = scope:oe_bet_p1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_bet_s1 value = 50 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_bet_c2 value = scope:oe_bet_p2 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_bet_s2 value = 35 }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_bet_p3 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_bet_c3 value = scope:oe_bet_p3 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_bet_s3 value = 30 }
    }
    else = {
        remove_variable = oe_bet_c3
        set_variable = { name = oe_bet_s3 value = 0 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Back claimant n (0 = only watch). The stake starts again from 0.
oe_bet_set_back = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_bet_back value = $n$ }
    set_variable = { name = oe_bet_stake value = 0 }
}

# BYZ scope. Back whoever leads now.
oe_bet_back_leader = {
    if = { limit = { oe_bet_leader_1 = yes } oe_bet_set_back = { n = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_bet_leader_2 = yes } oe_bet_set_back = { n = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_bet_leader_3 = yes } oe_bet_set_back = { n = 3 } }
}

# BYZ scope. Deeper commitment (amount 1-3, the stake stays within 0-3); the backed claimant gains `push`.
oe_bet_add_stake = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_bet_stake add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_bet_stake min = 0 max = 3 }
    oe_bet_push_backed = { amount = $push$ }
}

# BYZ scope. Changes the strength of claimant n by amount.
oe_bet_push = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_bet_s$n$ add = $amount$ }
    oe_bet_clamp = yes
}
oe_bet_push_backed = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 1 oe_bet_alive_1 = yes } oe_bet_push = { n = 1 amount = $amount$ } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 2 oe_bet_alive_2 = yes } oe_bet_push = { n = 2 amount = $amount$ } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 3 oe_bet_alive_3 = yes } oe_bet_push = { n = 3 amount = $amount$ } }
}
oe_bet_push_leader = {
    if = { limit = { oe_bet_leader_1 = yes } oe_bet_push = { n = 1 amount = $amount$ } }
    if = { limit = { oe_bet_leader_2 = yes } oe_bet_push = { n = 2 amount = $amount$ } }
    if = { limit = { oe_bet_leader_3 = yes } oe_bet_push = { n = 3 amount = $amount$ } }
}
oe_bet_clamp = {
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_bet_s1 min = 0 max = 100 }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_bet_s2 min = 0 max = 100 }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_bet_s3 min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly while a bet runs (main-line scheduler oe_ml_monthly, gen_mainline_lock.py).
oe_bet_monthly = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_bet_m add = 1 }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { NOT = { country_exists = c:TUR } has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active } }
        oe_bet_close = yes
    }
    else = {
        # Out of the race: dead or imprisoned.
        if = { limit = { oe_bet_alive_1 = no } set_variable = { name = oe_bet_s1 value = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_bet_alive_2 = no } set_variable = { name = oe_bet_s2 value = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_bet_alive_3 = no } set_variable = { name = oe_bet_s3 value = 0 } }
        # Fortune of war: -3 / 0 / +3.
        if = { limit = { oe_bet_alive_1 = yes } random_list = { 1 = { change_variable = { name = oe_bet_s1 add = 3 } } 1 = { change_variable = { name = oe_bet_s1 add = -3 } } 2 = { } } }
        if = { limit = { oe_bet_alive_2 = yes } random_list = { 1 = { change_variable = { name = oe_bet_s2 add = 3 } } 1 = { change_variable = { name = oe_bet_s2 add = -3 } } 2 = { } } }
        if = { limit = { oe_bet_alive_3 = yes } random_list = { 1 = { change_variable = { name = oe_bet_s3 add = 3 } } 1 = { change_variable = { name = oe_bet_s3 add = -3 } } 2 = { } } }
        # The claimant on the Ottoman throne holds the capital and the treasury.
        if = { limit = { oe_bet_alive_1 = yes var:oe_bet_c1 ?= { is_ruler_of = c:TUR } } change_variable = { name = oe_bet_s1 add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_bet_alive_2 = yes var:oe_bet_c2 ?= { is_ruler_of = c:TUR } } change_variable = { name = oe_bet_s2 add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_bet_alive_3 = yes var:oe_bet_c3 ?= { is_ruler_of = c:TUR } } change_variable = { name = oe_bet_s3 add = 1 } }
        # Byzantine backing: 1 + stake.
        if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 1 oe_bet_alive_1 = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_bet_s1 add = oe_bet_backing_push } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 2 oe_bet_alive_2 = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_bet_s2 add = oe_bet_backing_push } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 3 oe_bet_alive_3 = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_bet_s3 add = oe_bet_backing_push } }
        oe_bet_clamp = yes
        # The storyline's own monthly content.
        if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_round = 1 } oe_ivr_bet_monthly = yes }  # the Ottoman interregnum after Ankara (gen_interregnum.py)
        if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_round = 2 } oe_ths_bet_monthly = yes }  # the Mustafa revolt (gen_thessalonica.py)
        if = {
            limit = {
                oe_bet_running = yes
                OR = {
                    oe_bet_alive_n <= 1
                    var:oe_bet_s1 >= 90
                    var:oe_bet_s2 >= 90
                    var:oe_bet_s3 >= 90
                    var:oe_bet_m >= 144
                }
            }
            oe_bet_resolve = yes
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Decides the contest, puts the winner on the Ottoman throne if possible, and fires the storyline's settlement.
oe_bet_resolve = {
    set_variable = oe_bet_resolved
    if = { limit = { oe_bet_leader_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_bet_winner value = 1 } var:oe_bet_c1 = { save_scope_as = oe_bet_w } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_bet_leader_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_bet_winner value = 2 } var:oe_bet_c2 = { save_scope_as = oe_bet_w } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_bet_leader_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_bet_winner value = 3 } var:oe_bet_c3 = { save_scope_as = oe_bet_w } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_bet_winner value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_bet_w } set_variable = { name = oe_bet_wc value = scope:oe_bet_w } }
    # The winner takes the Ottoman throne: only alive, in the Ottoman state and not already its ruler.
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:oe_bet_w
            country_exists = c:TUR
            scope:oe_bet_w = { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:TUR NOT = { is_ruler_of = c:TUR } }
        }
        c:TUR = { set_new_ruler = scope:oe_bet_w }
    }
    # Byzantium's outcome.
    if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 0 } set_variable = oe_bet_out_aloof }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_winner >= 1 var:oe_bet_back = var:oe_bet_winner } set_variable = oe_bet_out_won }
    else = { set_variable = oe_bet_out_lost }
    # The storyline's settlement event.
    if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_round = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ivr.8 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_round = 2 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.14 }
}

# BYZ scope. Clears the whole bet.
oe_bet_close = {
    remove_variable = oe_bet_round
    remove_variable = oe_bet_resolved
    remove_variable = oe_bet_c1
    remove_variable = oe_bet_c2
    remove_variable = oe_bet_c3
    remove_variable = oe_bet_s1
    remove_variable = oe_bet_s2
    remove_variable = oe_bet_s3
    remove_variable = oe_bet_back
    remove_variable = oe_bet_stake
    remove_variable = oe_bet_m
    remove_variable = oe_bet_winner
    remove_variable = oe_bet_wc
    remove_variable = oe_bet_out_won
    remove_variable = oe_bet_out_lost
    remove_variable = oe_bet_out_aloof
}
